source_readback: All nine working files matched git show of the exact inspected candidate. No production, workflow or test edits were made during this review.

observed_facts.appcontainer_cmd: Exit 22 after first child-created marker; child-delete.txt remains, attributes 32; stderr contains Access is denied. The unchanged batch's line 41 maps 22 to del's errorlevel.
observed_facts.lpac_cmd: Exit 1 with both streams empty and no first marker. It did not reach the same observed phase as AppContainer cmd.
observed_facts.actual_c_children: Both modes exited 0 and completed 35 diagnostic records. DELETE opens and DeleteFileW succeeded on the original allowed child and four inherited/explicit, Medium/Low comparison files; protected .git and outside NULL-DACL targets were denied.
observed_facts.security_boundary: Workspace package allow mask is 0x1301bf, without FILE_DELETE_CHILD. The deliberate contaminated-parent control proves adding parent FILE_DELETE_CHILD permits deletion of the protected descendant.
observed_facts.scope: The C results do not qualify original cmd, loader initialization, managed-account launch, IPC, or production admission.

shared: Common fixture() produces the original target ACLs and original CHILD_SCRIPT bytes.
Same SECURITY_CAPABILITIES shape: freshly created package SID, zero capabilities; same LPAC all-packages opt-out in LPAC mode.
Same explicit three-file stdio handle list, no inherited ambient handles, same STARTF_USESTDHANDLES and CreateProcessW flags.
Same validated LOCALAPPDATA and SystemRoot/TEMP/TMP/windir construction and workspace CWD.
Both query actual suspended-child package SID, user SID, Low integrity and zero capabilities, and independently check package access mode before resume.
differences: The cmd child executes the system cmd.exe and original batch; the C child executes a separately compiled minimal native binary.
The cmd environment additionally contains ComSpec. The C environment is therefore not byte-identical.

The cmd path performs token impersonation controls before resume. Their mutation targets are distinct inside-*, matrix and contaminated-parent objects; they do not modify child-delete.txt, child-delete-dir or the original batch.
The trace adds four diagnostic files and its executable in its separate fixture; the two modes use different fresh profiles and separate fixture roots.

win32_api.py:564-597 exact stdio; :609-716 actual cmd creation
child_trace.py:41-151 native creation; :154-246 separate fixture and actual token verification

incoming_c52.delta: 52 added C lines; all original C lines and original Python/probe predicates remain.
measures: FindFirstFileW on child-delete.txt, child-probe.cmd and * using both relative and absolute forms; every valid search handle is closed.
CreateFileW(FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY) on relative and absolute CWD with FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS and FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT.
GetFullPathNameW with bounded static buffer, followed by a nonmutating DELETE open of the original child using its absolute path.
incoming_c52.status: Not yet observed in a native run at receipt time. Do not report these operations as passed.
incoming_c52.limits: GetFullPathNameW constructs an absolute path without validating existence or converting short components to long components. Its success cannot prove GetLongPathNameW/GetShortPathNameW access.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: Directory enumeration or an absolute-path access step used by the shell fails.
causal_hypotheses.status: C52 will discriminate the measured operations. Existing direct relative DeleteFileW success does not answer directory enumeration.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: Short/long name conversion queries an ungranted ancestor such as the RUNNER~1 component.
causal_hypotheses.status: Plausible from the observed path and documented API requirements; no evidence yet that this cmd.exe version actually calls either conversion API. Not an authorization to grant ancestor read or list access.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: LPAC cmd initialization or batch resolution requires a resource not used by the minimal C binary.
causal_hypotheses.status: The earlier LPAC failure phase supports separating initialization from batch execution; it does not identify a registry key, DLL or capability to grant.

next_evidence_decisions.when: C52 relative enumeration or FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY fails
next_evidence_decisions.step: Use its exact operation, path, error and actual token/ACL evidence to investigate that failing access; preserve the original cmd and deletion boundary as gates.

next_evidence_decisions.when: Relative forms pass but absolute forms fail
next_evidence_decisions.step: Inspect the exact converted path and parent-chain behavior using only read-only operation probes; do not broaden parent ACLs.

next_evidence_decisions.when: All C52 operations pass but original AppContainer cmd remains exit 22
next_evidence_decisions.step: Add only bounded read-only GetLongPathNameW/GetShortPathNameW calls on the two existing target paths, or capture actual native cmd file-operation failures. A failing conversion narrows a hypothesis but is not proof that it caused cmd failure.

next_evidence_decisions.when: LPAC remains exit 1 before the first original marker
next_evidence_decisions.step: Use a separate, fixed diagnostic cmd control with an expected distinct inline exit code, preserving the original batch test unchanged. If initialization works, compare a separate owned fixed batch with the same token/stdio/environment; query every actual child token. Do not add generic capabilities or extend original deadlines.

smallest_rust_qualification_step.status: Design only; no code added and no production route enabled.
smallest_rust_qualification_step.step: After original cmd behavior is understood, implement a private owned AppContainer launch experiment around the existing job, desktop and explicit stdio resources, then execute the unchanged original command and negative filesystem contracts under the original managed identity.
concrete_gap: proc_thread_attr.rs currently owns only handle/job buffers and pseudoconsole; it has no SECURITY_CAPABILITIES or LPAC attribute owner. Any new attribute values/SID storage must outlive DeleteProcThreadAttributeList.

PreparedProcessContext owns PreparedFilesystemToken from CreateRestrictedToken with a required non-AppContainer base. This is not an AppContainer authority and cannot be reused by relabeling it as qualified.
elevated/runner_client.rs CreateProcessWithLogonW explicitly uses dwlogonflags=0; the current design intentionally does not load sandbox-user profile state.

CreateAppContainerProfile creates a per-user profile in the calling identity. The CI user's successful native profile lifecycle does not prove the managed sandbox user's profile/environment lifecycle.
FreshManagedRunnerBase remains parent-local and retains the original managed process/token/filesystem identity. A child-side reconstruction from wire SID/path/PID values is not equivalent.

process.rs currently runs CreateProcessAsUserW without a suspended actual-token admission check; a new experimental launch must observe and validate the actual child before resume while retaining its owners.
retained_gates: All legacy and unqualified elevated APIs remain refused.
Original cmd env/output/exit, real read/deny-read, private setup state, IPC/transport and route cleanup tests remain.
Original four-cell delete oracle and protected descendant/NULL-DACL counterexamples remain.
No FILE_DELETE_CHILD grant to writable roots, broad capability addition, parent ACL widening or conversion of C diagnostic completion into production success.
smallest_rust_qualification_step.architectural_limit: A single production guard removal or raw token factory change cannot satisfy the retained contracts. A qualified composition and explicit API migration are required; the existing raw-token positive and raw-token refusal tests describe incompatible unconditional use without qualification.

primary_sources.claim: Absolute-path construction does not validate the target and does not convert short names to long names.
Long-name conversion can require querying parent directories and fail when that query is denied.
Short-name conversion can also fail on a parent directory query.
Profiles are per-user and per-app; creating for another user requires impersonating that user.
Process creation can succeed before DLL initialization completes and does not automatically load the target user's profile.
SECURITY_CAPABILITIES creates an AppContainer; attribute value storage must remain valid until attribute list destruction.
